site_changes.description: feat(agent-haven): add /llms.txt agent-discovery endpoints
feat(analytics): add Plausible tracking to public pages
fix(dashboard): sample download links 404 (relative paths break on Pages)
fix(tests): remove hardcoded 92-dataset baseline from index resource test
docs(readme): replace 15 hardcoded dataset badges with status legend
fix(badges): regenerate status badges after browser-dependent status restore
fix(trust): copy namespace from manifest into per-dataset health records
fix(transport): backfill namespace, restore browser-dependent status, document kuantan 404
feat(transport): add 30 GTFS datasets (16 static + 14 realtime)
fix(trust): add freshness extractors for 11 gap datasets
fix(trust): distinguish unknown-freshness from stale (Last-Modified-only bug)
feat(trust): replace misleading "all healthy" with honest status taxonomy
docs: openwiki weekly refresh (2026-08-03)
feat(adoption): add issue + PR templates for adopt-a-dataset flow
docs(mcp): update endpoint to live mcp.data-pulse.my (was placeholder mcp.datapulse-my.my)
docs(dashboard): link to MCP endpoint
docs(readme): add MCP server callout + Claude Desktop config
docs(llms.txt): advertise MCP server (endpoint, tools, resources, Claude Desktop)
docs(mcp): document deploy and verification
deploy(mcp): add cloudflare tunnel ingress template
